description: This file defines the interface for the SystemInfo class within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, hostname, and environment variables, as well as related metadata and build information. The file also declares external functions and metadata used across the system.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system-related information and operations such as memory, CPU, hostname, environment variables, and system time management.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of system memory statistics, with the ability to output its data as a JSON string.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates an identifier based on raw device ID and key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force the change.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: GetHostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the system.

methods.name: GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Returns the number of physical pages.

methods.name: GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: GetCpuLoadAvg
methods.description: Returns an array of CPU load averages.

methods.name: TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory statistics.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Outputs the memory snapshot as a JSON string.
